title: Scalar compatibility of integrated smooth-section specialization
statement: Let A,B be finite commutative rings with φ:A→B, and let M,N>0 satisfy M dividing N, N A=0 and M B=0. Let S be Noetherian with N and M invertible, and let g:V→S be a compactifiable separated quasi-compact smooth morphism of pure relative dimension d with closed section s and its finite-ring Geometry witness [lem-trf-finite-ring-section-deformation]. Supply the canonical Cartesian cone-to-conormal-bundle squares and family isomorphisms κ_A and κ_B normalized at one [def-pur-finite-smooth-canonical-maps]. Let t be the root-power, generator and derived-counit normalized coefficient-line comparison from exponent N to exponent M [def-pur-finite-smooth-coefficient-arrows]. Write ψ_A and ψ_B for integratedSpecialization, zero specialization followed by the inverse cone-to-bundle section mate and the inverse bundle-integration adjunct [lem-sp-finite-section-integrated-specialization-base-change]. Then Q_S(ψ_A) ≫ (t.tensorPower d).hom = q_(g,s) ≫ ψ_B, where q_(g,s) is the actual exceptional coefficient section map [def-pur-dnc-coefficient-section-maps]. There is no diagonal factor or smooth orientation in this assertion.

source.place: (3), Orientation, deformation and vector integration factors; general-ring proof (2)

proof.text: Use the normalized zero-fibre specialization coefficient square, separately from bundle integration. Since N kills A it also kills B under φ; no change-of-exponent condition enters specialization.

Apply section_scalar_base_change to the canonical bundle-to-cone Cartesian square over the identity of S. Smoothness of the normal projection follows by pullback from the Rees projection, and the cone-to-bundle isomorphism transfers it to the bundle projection. The homogeneous cone comparison respects the zero section. The identity-pullback scalar coherence equation converts its section square into q_bundle≫normalSectionMap_B=Q(normalSectionMap_A)≫q_normal. This is the proved private normalSectionMap_scalar helper.

Apply the root-power-normalized scalar square for the bundle zero-section adjunct to the conormal bundle. It compares the adjunct at exponent N over A with the adjunct at exponent M over B through t.tensorPower d.

Postcompose the desired equality with the B bundleSectionAdjoint followed by normalSectionMap_B; both are invertible. Replace the tensor-comparison/adjunct composite by the scalar adjunct square. Replace the next bundle/cone composite by normalSectionMap_scalar. Functoriality combines the three A factors, and integratedSpecialization_normalization identifies their composite with specialization_A. The zero-fibre scalar square gives q_(g,s)≫specialization_B; the B normalization equation restores the postcomposed right side. Cancel the two invertible B maps. No inverse coefficient map, orientation, or diagonal factor is assumed.

proof_origin.place: (3), Orientation: separate specialization and bundle-adjunct squares, proved cone square and categorical cancellation

lean.statement:
theorem integratedSpecialization_scalar
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (N M : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hM : 0 < M) (hMN : M ∣ N)
    (hA : (N : A) = 0) (hB : (M : B) = 0)
    {V S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian S]
    (d : ℕ) (g : V ⟶ S) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d g]
    [HasCompactification g] [IsSeparated g] [QuasiCompact g]
    (s : S ⟶ V) [IsClosedImmersion s]
    [FiniteRingSectionDeformation.Geometry d g s] (hs : s ≫ g = 𝟙 S)
    (sq : IsPullback
      ((reesConeComparison s ≪≫ FiniteRingSectionDeformation.coneBundleIso d g s).hom)
      (Scheme.Hom.normalConeProj g s)
      (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d (ConormalGradedAlgebra.piece s 1)) (𝟙 S))
    (sq' : IsPullback
      ((reesConeComparison s ≪≫ FiniteRingSectionDeformation.coneBundleIso d g s).hom)
      (Scheme.Hom.normalConeProj g s)
      (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d (ConormalGradedAlgebra.piece s 1)) (𝟙 S))
    (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) (hS' : IsUnit (M : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (κ : NoetherianSectionSpecialization.family A g s ≅
      (ordinaryFinitePullback A (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S ↘ S)).obj
        (sectionInvariant A g s))
    (κ' : NoetherianSectionSpecialization.family B g s ≅
      (ordinaryFinitePullback B (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) S ↘ S)).obj
        (sectionInvariant B g s))
    (hκ : NoetherianSectionSpecialization.Normalized A g s hs κ)
    (hκ' : NoetherianSectionSpecialization.Normalized B g s hs κ')
    (t : CoefficientLineComparison φ N M hA hB S) :
    (ordinaryScalar φ S).map
        (integratedSpecialization A d g s hs sq N hN hA hS κ) ≫
        (t.tensorPower d).hom =
      WeilConjectures.DncCoefficientTransport.sectionMap φ g s ≫
        integratedSpecialization B d g s hs sq' M hM hB hS' κ'
